basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/SOCRadarEntraID/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [SOCRadar Entra ID Integration](https://socradar.io/) for Microsoft Sentinel automatically responds to leaked employee credentials detected by SOCRadar's Dark Web Monitoring. Pulls Botnet Data, PII Exposure, and VIP Protection alerts from the SOCRadar XTI Platform, looks up matching identities in Microsoft Entra ID, and takes configurable remediation actions (revoke sessions, force MFA re-registration, disable account, add to quarantine group, password reset, mark as compromised in Identity Protection). Authentication is secretless via Workload Identity Federation. Data ingestion uses the modern DCR-based Logs Ingestion API. **Workbooks:** 4, **Function Apps:** 1, [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs four workbooks to visualize leaked credentials detected by SOCRadar across Botnet, PII Exposure, and VIP Protection sources, plus a combined remediation dashboard.
Botnet leak detail with the Microsoft Entra ID match status and the remediation actions taken.
Breach-sourced credentials with the Microsoft Entra ID match status and the remediation outcome.
VIP user exposures found by SOCRadar, matched against Microsoft Entra ID.
All SOCRadar sources (Botnet Data, PII Exposure, VIP Protection) with remediation actions and the audit summary.

This solution installs an Azure Function App playbook that pulls leaked credentials from SOCRadar on a timer schedule (default every 6 hours), looks each up in Entra ID, and takes configurable response actions via Microsoft Graph.
